scripts.dev:client: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.install:all: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; spawnSync(cmd, ['install', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); spawnSync(cmd, ['install', '--prefix', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.build: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; spawnSync(cmd, ['run', 'build', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
